brief:
US singer Zach Bryan wore a "Free Palestine" shirt during a performance at Gillette Stadium in Massachusetts, Al Jazeera English reported. The concert took place at the venue owned by Robert Kraft, the New England Patriots owner.

The shirt's display comes amid ongoing international attention to statements of political solidarity at major entertainment events. Bryan's message was visible to thousands of attendees at the stadium.
dek: US singer Zach Bryan wore a ‘Free Palestine’ shirt while performing at Gillette Stadium, owned by Robert Kraft.
title: Zach Bryan wears Free Palestine shirt at Gillette Stadium concert
